summary: Collision-processing mode dispatcher. Reads a mode selector at this+0x1C and switches on it: modes 0-5 run a guarded computation on this and then compute a collision contact impulse from a2 and a3; mode 6 accumulates vehicle contact force from a2 with the constant 1; any other value returns the mode unchanged. Dispatches through a jump table global. Called per frame by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch.

operations.description: Read the mode selector into result from this+0x1C (this[7]).

Switch on the mode value, dispatching through the jump table global at 0x0040F52C. Modes 0-5 take the collision-impulse path, mode 6 the vehicle-contact path, and the default path returns immediately.
For modes 0-5, run the guarded computation ShortComputation_f0d0 on this.
For modes 0-5, compute the collision contact impulse from a2 and a3 and store its result.
For mode 6, accumulate vehicle contact force from a2 with the constant argument 1 and store its result.
Return the computed result; the default case returns the unmodified mode value.

clean_pseudocode: case 0..5: ShortComputation_f0d0(this); result = CollisionContactImpulse(a2, a3); break;
